name: aibeat-site
description: AI Beat product and documentation site built with Mintlify.

scripts.check: npm run check:skills && npm run check:agentbeat-preview && npm run check:bilingual && mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects
scripts.build:community: npm --prefix ../community-site run build && rm -rf public/community && mkdir -p public && cp -a ../community-site/dist public/community
scripts.build:site: npm run build:skills && npm run build:agentbeat-preview && rm -rf .build && mkdir -p .build && mint export --disable-openapi --output .build/aibeat-site.zip && npm run check:export
scripts.build: npm run build:community && npm run build:site
